svg.title: OptionPrint packet layout
svg.text: 248 bytes, fixed size · little-endian, packed · offsets from message start

g.title: Header
Header
okey: OptionKey, offset 28, 27 bytes - option key (ticker + expiry + strike + call/put)
okey: OptionKey, offset 28, 27 bytes - option key (ticker + expiry + strike + call/put)
prtExch: enum OptExch, offset 55, 1 bytes - exchange reporting the print
prtSize: int32, offset 56, 4 bytes - print size [contracts]
prtPrice: float32, offset 60, 4 bytes - print price

g.data-desc: incremental print cluster counter (one counter per okey; used to group prints into clusters)
g.title: prtClusterNum: int32, offset 64, 4 bytes - incremental print cluster counter (one counter per okey; used to group prints into clusters)

g.data-desc: cumulative size of prints in this sequence (sequence of prints @ same or more aggressive price with less than 25 ms elapsing since first print; can span exchanges)
g.title: prtClusterSize: int32, offset 68, 4 bytes - cumulative size of prints in this sequence (sequence of prints @ same or more aggressive price with less than 25 ms elapsing since first print; can span exchanges)

g.data-desc: print type, NREG is european non-regular print
g.title: prtType: enum PrtType, offset 72, 1 bytes - print type, NREG is european non-regular print
printCodes: char[36], offset 73, 36 bytes - european trade condition codes
printCodes: char[36], offset 73, 36 bytes - european trade condition codes
prtOrders: uint16, offset 109, 2 bytes - number of participating orders

g.data-desc: day print volume in contracts [this exchange]
g.title: prtVolume: int32, offset 111, 4 bytes - day print volume in contracts [this exchange]

g.data-desc: day print volume in contracts [this exchange]
g.title: prtVolume: int32, offset 111, 4 bytes - day print volume in contracts [this exchange]

g.data-desc: day print/cancel volume (num of contracts printed and then cancelled)
g.title: cxlVolume: int32, offset 115, 4 bytes - day print/cancel volume (num of contracts printed and then cancelled)

bidCount: uint16, offset 119, 2 bytes - number of bid prints
askCount: uint16, offset 121, 2 bytes - number of ask prints

askVolume: int32, offset 127, 4 bytes - ask print volume in contracts
askVolume: int32, offset 127, 4 bytes - ask print volume in contracts
ebid: float32, offset 131, 4 bytes - exchange bid (@ print time)
eask: float32, offset 135, 4 bytes - exchange ask (@ print time)
eask: float32, offset 135, 4 bytes - exchange ask (@ print time)

easz: int32, offset 143, 4 bytes - exchange ask size
easz: int32, offset 143, 4 bytes - exchange ask size

g.title: eage: float32, offset 147, 4 bytes - age of prevailing quote at time of print

bidPrice2: float32, offset 159, 4 bytes - 2nd best bid price (@ print time)

g.title: prtSide: enum PrtSide, offset 207, 1 bytes - implied print side (based on ebid/eask and nbbo market)

g.data-desc: the matching engine's or participant's time where the feed carries one, else the sender's stamp
g.title: prtTimestamp: int64 (Unix ns), offset 208, 8 bytes - the matching engine's or participant's time where the feed carries one, else the sender's stamp

g.data-desc: inbound packet PTP timestamp from SR gateway switch; synchronized with facility grandfather clock
g.title: netTimestamp: int64 (Unix ns), offset 216, 8 bytes - inbound packet PTP timestamp from SR gateway switch; synchronized with facility grandfather clock

g.data-desc: SR system timestamp of the most recent record update
g.title: timestamp: DateTime (int64 ticks), offset 232, 8 bytes - SR system timestamp of the most recent record update

g.data-desc: source high-precision timestamp (if available): the SIP's, the exchange gateway's or a vendor's; 0 when the feed carries none
g.title: srcTimestamp: int64 (Unix ns), offset 240, 8 bytes - source high-precision timestamp (if available): the SIP's, the exchange gateway's or a vendor's; 0 when the feed carries none
